provenance.historical_register_assessment: Only inspected vendor observations are reused for unchanged component questions. Historical model/plan headings are not current authority.

accounting_rules.purchase_basis: Whole listed packages, spools and stock lengths. No equipment presumed owned. One battery installed; entire two-battery package purchased.
accounting_rules.money: Decimal arithmetic; retain source values and unrounded conversions. Final complete vehicle total quantized to AUD 0.01. Cap 499.99 AUD excluding tax and shipping. Unknown quantity, price, currency, tax or FX prevents complete-cost compliance.
accounting_rules.PETG: Printed-part cost excluded by requirement; installed mass included. Other adhesives, hardware and purchased stock are not excluded.
accounting_rules.ground: Reusable transmitter, charger, supply, test and ground-safety equipment separately purchased and priced, not hidden in vehicle cap or assumed owned.
accounting_rules.mass: Every physical item owned once. Commercial mass replaces CAD envelope-density mass. Study allowances are replaced, not added, when actual CAD component masses arrive.
accounting_rules.availability: A numerically priced sold-out component is not a procurable selection.
accounting_rules.sources: Reused M2 observations retain original URLs and access dates in the current read records. No unidentified dollar amount receives an assumed currency.

rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to 0.01 AUD after summing unrounded available contributions
